summary: Super Admin Revenue Metrics feature fully tested - all backend APIs (29/29 tests) and frontend UI working correctly. MRR/ARR calculation, plan distribution, overdue alerts, payment history, and plan change functionality all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Revenue endpoint correctly calculates MRR from active subscriptions with total_monthly > 0
Plan distribution properly categorizes plans by type (direct/partner/trial/free)
Overdue alerts correctly identify companies with expired subscription periods
Plan change endpoint validates plan_id against PLAN_PRICES dictionary and returns 400 for invalid plans
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 21 companies in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin Revenue features at /admin route fully functional. Revenue tab (data-testid='tab-revenue') shows MRR, ARR, Partners, Vencidos KPIs. Plan distribution shows all plan types with company counts and MRR. Overdue alerts show companies with expired subscriptions. Plan change dialog (data-testid='plan-select', 'confirm-plan-change') works for all 8 plan types. Current MRR: RD$17,000, ARR: RD$204,000, 4 partner companies, 4 overdue alerts.

backend.test: plan_distribution has plan_name, count, mrr, type fields
overdue_alerts structure with company_id, company_name, days_overdue
partner_companies and partner_mrr are valid numbers
POST /api/super-admin/companies/{id}/plan with custom_price uses custom price
